intent: exploratory technical characterization; no human-subject or runtime-speedup inference
analysis: Per-program percentage reductions; pooled median and IQR; per-seed summaries; seed-cluster percentile bootstrap of pooled paired median arithmetic minus instruction reduction, 2000 resamples, seed 87123; Wilson intervals for synthetic frequencies. No p-values or claims about real workload prevalence.
missing_data: Any subprocess error, malformed measurement or strict numerical disagreement fails the run; nothing is silently excluded.
stopping_rule: Run every declared program and every arm; do not tune generator or optimizer from the reported evaluation.
falsifiers: chain cost differs from exhaustive parenthesization minimum
square or elementwise control has chain savings
cost_convention: Conventional mathematical scalar arithmetic: m*p*(2*n-1) per matmul, r*c for entrywise operations, zero for movement/constructors. VM additionally adds the first product to an initial +0 accumulator. This model is not an executed-instruction counter or a runtime predictor.
